title: Python
semantics: Run user Python 3.13 code on the Loginom server in a separate process (Linux: the only mode; the wizard checkbox is forced on). One optional tabular input (port 0) read with InputTable.Get/IsNull or builtin_pandas_utils.to_data_frame, one tabular output (port 0) written with OutputTable.Append/Set or prepare_compatible_table/fill_table. Output schema is either declared in the wizard (schema_mode=declared) or created by the code (schema_mode=code). Only the standard library, pandas 2.2.3 and numpy 2.2.4 installed on the server; no package installation, network, files, environments (PY_ENV) or input variables in this slice. Loginom executes the code; the handler never computes values. Preview runs the whole script and is not a configuration check.

parameter_schema.description: New node requires source_text and schema_mode (and columns for declared). Existing node: {} keeps saved code and schema; send expected_source_sha256 from readback to replace code.

source_text.description: Complete Python source saved in the node exactly as given. Read input via InputTable (None when the port is not linked), write rows via OutputTable.Append() then Set(name_or_index, value). Values: bool, int, float, str, datetime.datetime, None.

expected_source_sha256.description: Existing node only: SHA-256 of the saved source from readback; the replacement is refused if the node code changed.

schema_mode.description: declared: output columns fixed in the wizard by columns; code: «Разрешить формировать выходные столбцы из кода» on, the script creates columns (AddColumn/AssignColumns/prepare_compatible_table) before the first Append.

columns.description: schema_mode=declared only: output columns in order. Forbidden for schema_mode=code.

type.description: Loginom data type of the column.

readback.description: Compact: no source text, only identity and schema.

fields.freshness: not_executed | executed | failed (+ exact Loginom error text)
